test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: In which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India is it mentioned that “it shall be the duty of every citizen of India to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem”?
solution:
The correct answer is __**51A (a)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 51A of the Constitution of India enumerates the Fundamental Duties of every citizen of India.
 
• Clause (a) of Article 51A states that "it shall be the duty of every citizen of India to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem".
 
• Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• These duties serve as a constant reminder to citizens that while enjoying their rights, they must also be conscious of the duties they owe to their country, their society, and to their fellow citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties**

 
 
• The Fundamental Duties are a set of tenets enshrined in Part IVA of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Initially, there were ten Fundamental Duties; later, an eleventh duty was added by the 86th Amendment Act, 2002.
 
• These duties are inspired by the Constitution of the former Soviet Union and aim to instill a sense of patriotic citizenship among Indian citizens.
 
• Unlike Fundamental Rights, Fundamental Duties are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced by the courts for their violation.
 
 
 
• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**
 
 
• Also known as the "Mini-Constitution," the 42nd Amendment Act is one of the most comprehensive amendments to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It brought about significant changes, including the addition of Fundamental Duties and the alteration of the Preamble to include the terms "Socialist" and "Secular."
 
• It also curtailed the power of the judiciary and increased the power of the central government, making it a controversial amendment.
 
 
 
• **National Flag and National Anthem**
 
 
• The National Flag of India, also known as the Tiranga, consists of three horizontal stripes of saffron, white, and green, with a 24-spoke navy blue Ashoka Chakra in the center.
 
• The National Anthem of India, "Jana Gana Mana," was composed by Rabindranath Tagore and adopted by the Constituent Assembly as the National Anthem on January 24, 1950.
 
• Both the National Flag and National Anthem are symbols of India's sovereignty, unity, and integrity, and are to be respected by all citizens.
